# ToolboxPro

> 100+ free online tools that run entirely in your browser. No signup, no file uploads, no usage limits. All processing happens client-side for maximum privacy.

ToolboxPro offers free online utilities for developers, designers, writers, and everyday users. Every tool processes data locally in the browser — files never leave the user's device. The site is ad-supported and requires no account.

## Key Differentiators
- **Privacy-first**: All processing is client-side (JavaScript, Canvas, WebAssembly). No file uploads.
- **No signup**: No account, email, or personal data required for any tool.
- **No limits**: No daily quotas, no watermarks, no premium tiers.
- **Open access**: Free for personal and commercial use.

## Developer Tools

- [JSON Formatter & Validator](https://trytoolboxpro.com/tools/json-formatter): Format, validate, and beautify JSON data instantly. Fix syntax errors and make your JSON readable with intelligent auto-formatting and tree view.
- [Base64 Encoder/Decoder](https://trytoolboxpro.com/tools/base64-encode-decode): Encode text, files, or images to Base64 format and decode them back. Perfect for inline data URIs and API testing workflows.
- [Regex Tester](https://trytoolboxpro.com/tools/regex-tester): Test regular expressions with real-time highlighting
- [Color Converter](https://trytoolboxpro.com/tools/color-converter): Convert colors between HEX, RGB, HSL, CMYK, and HSV formats instantly. Preview colors, get hex codes, and generate harmonious palettes.
- [URL Encoder/Decoder](https://trytoolboxpro.com/tools/url-encoder-decoder): Encode and decode URL components, query strings, and full URLs. Fix broken links and prepare URLs for API requests safely.
- [UUID Generator](https://trytoolboxpro.com/tools/uuid-generator): Generate random UUID v4 identifiers instantly. Bulk generate unique IDs for databases, APIs, distributed systems, and test data.
- [Hash Generator](https://trytoolboxpro.com/tools/hash-generator): Generate SHA-256, SHA-384, SHA-512 hashes for any text or file. Compare checksums and verify data integrity with multiple hash algorithms.
- [Timestamp Converter](https://trytoolboxpro.com/tools/timestamp-converter): Convert between Unix timestamps and human-readable dates
- [Number Base Converter](https://trytoolboxpro.com/tools/number-base-converter): Convert between binary, octal, decimal, and hexadecimal
- [CSS Minifier](https://trytoolboxpro.com/tools/css-minifier): Minify and compress CSS code to reduce file size and improve page load speed. Remove whitespace, comments, and redundant rules safely.
- [SQL Formatter](https://trytoolboxpro.com/tools/sql-formatter): Format and beautify SQL queries for better readability
- [JSON to YAML Converter](https://trytoolboxpro.com/tools/json-to-yaml): Convert JSON data to clean YAML format and vice versa. Preserve nested structures, arrays, and data types during conversion.
- [String Escaper/Unescaper](https://trytoolboxpro.com/tools/string-escaper): Escape and unescape special characters in strings for JSON, HTML, URLs, SQL, and JavaScript. Handle all common escaping formats.
- [HTML Tag Stripper](https://trytoolboxpro.com/tools/html-tag-stripper): Remove all HTML tags from text, keeping only content
- [JWT Decoder](https://trytoolboxpro.com/tools/jwt-decoder): Decode JWT tokens and inspect header, payload, and signature
- [Cron Expression Parser](https://trytoolboxpro.com/tools/cron-parser): Parse cron expressions and get human-readable schedules
- [HTML Preview](https://trytoolboxpro.com/tools/html-preview): Write and preview HTML code in real-time in a sandbox
- [CSV Viewer & Formatter](https://trytoolboxpro.com/tools/csv-viewer): View CSV data in a formatted table with auto-detection
- [IP Subnet Calculator](https://trytoolboxpro.com/tools/ip-calculator): Calculate network subnet, CIDR, broadcast, and host range
- [JWT Generator](https://trytoolboxpro.com/tools/jwt-generator): Generate JWT tokens with custom header and payload
- [JSON Diff](https://trytoolboxpro.com/tools/json-diff): Compare two JSON objects and highlight differences
- [HTTP Status Codes](https://trytoolboxpro.com/tools/http-status-codes): Browse and search all HTTP status codes with descriptions
- [Markdown to HTML](https://trytoolboxpro.com/tools/markdown-to-html): Convert Markdown text to formatted HTML in real-time
- [CSS Gradient Generator](https://trytoolboxpro.com/tools/css-gradient): Create beautiful linear and radial CSS gradients visually. Copy the generated CSS code for backgrounds, buttons, and UI elements.
- [CSS Box Shadow Generator](https://trytoolboxpro.com/tools/css-shadow): Design and preview custom CSS box shadows visually
- [JSON to TypeScript](https://trytoolboxpro.com/tools/json-to-typescript): Convert JSON data to TypeScript interfaces automatically. Generate type definitions from any JSON object or API response.

## Text Tools

- [Word & Character Counter](https://trytoolboxpro.com/tools/word-counter): Count words, characters, sentences, and reading time
- [Text Case Converter](https://trytoolboxpro.com/tools/case-converter): Convert text between UPPER, lower, Title, camelCase and more
- [Lorem Ipsum Generator](https://trytoolboxpro.com/tools/lorem-ipsum-generator): Generate placeholder text for design mockups, website wireframes, and print layouts. Customize paragraph count, word length, and format.
- [Text Diff Checker](https://trytoolboxpro.com/tools/text-diff-checker): Compare two blocks of text side by side and highlight every difference. Perfect for code reviews, document revisions, and plagiarism checks.
- [Text Repeater](https://trytoolboxpro.com/tools/text-repeater): Repeat any text multiple times with custom separators, line breaks, or prefixes. Generate test data, patterns, and repeated strings instantly.
- [Text to Binary Converter](https://trytoolboxpro.com/tools/text-to-binary): Convert text to binary code and binary back to text
- [Text to URL Slug](https://trytoolboxpro.com/tools/text-to-slug): Convert any text into clean, SEO-friendly URL slugs. Remove special characters, normalize spaces, and generate optimized permalinks.
- [Text Sorter](https://trytoolboxpro.com/tools/text-sorter): Sort text lines alphabetically (A-Z or Z-A), by line length, or in reverse order. Remove duplicates and organize lists instantly.
- [Line Deduplicator](https://trytoolboxpro.com/tools/text-deduplicator): Remove duplicate lines from text while preserving order
- [Text Reverser](https://trytoolboxpro.com/tools/text-reverser): Reverse text, words, sentences, or entire lines instantly. Useful for creating mirrored text, solving puzzles, or formatting data.
- [Random String Generator](https://trytoolboxpro.com/tools/random-string-generator): Generate random strings with custom characters and length
- [Palindrome Checker](https://trytoolboxpro.com/tools/palindrome-checker): Check if text reads the same forwards and backwards
- [Morse Code Converter](https://trytoolboxpro.com/tools/morse-code-converter): Convert text to Morse code and decode Morse code back to readable text. Learn Morse alphabet with visual audio playback support.
- [Emoji Remover](https://trytoolboxpro.com/tools/emoji-remover): Remove all emoji characters from text while keeping words
- [Unicode Character Detector](https://trytoolboxpro.com/tools/unicode-detector): Inspect Unicode characters with codepoint and category info
- [Caesar Cipher](https://trytoolboxpro.com/tools/caesar-cipher): Encode and decode text using the classic Caesar shift cipher. Choose shift values, try brute force decoding, and learn cryptography basics.
- [Binary to Text](https://trytoolboxpro.com/tools/binary-to-text): Convert binary code to text and text back to binary
- [Online Notepad](https://trytoolboxpro.com/tools/online-notepad): Quick notepad with auto-save
- [Text Statistics Analyzer](https://trytoolboxpro.com/tools/text-statistics): Analyze text for word count, character count, sentence count, paragraph count, reading time, and keyword density

- [Image to Sketch](https://trytoolboxpro.com/tools/image-to-sketch): Convert photos into pencil sketch drawings and line art. Apply artistic filters to create realistic hand-drawn effects from your images.
- [Image Invert](https://trytoolboxpro.com/tools/image-invert): Invert or negate colors in any image instantly. Create negative effects, X-ray looks, and artistic color reversals with one click.
- [Photo Collage Maker](https://trytoolboxpro.com/tools/image-collage): Combine multiple photos into a beautiful collage grid. Choose layouts, spacing, background colors, and export in high resolution.
- [Color Palette Generator](https://trytoolboxpro.com/tools/color-palette): Generate harmonious color palettes from a base color
- [Color Blindness Simulator](https://trytoolboxpro.com/tools/color-blindness-simulator): Simulate how images appear to users with protanopia, deuteranopia, and tritanopia
